score.hundred: 100 = error rate 0: the engine's best play on every decision
score.zero: 0 = a random legal play's error rate in the same league (League 1: 121.1, League 2: 117.9, League 3: 117.6; late entries: the league whose field they played); below 0 = worse than a random legal play. score = 100 × (1 − error rate / Random's error rate in that league); error rate (PR) = 500 × mean GNUbg equity loss per decision
